name: gantt-chart-webui
description: Project management system with Gantt charts, WBS, and real-time collaboration

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.version:check:all: npm run version:check && cd backend && npm run version:check && cd ../frontend && npm run version:check
scripts.version:bump:patch: ./scripts/release.sh sync-versions && cd backend && npm run version:bump:patch && cd ../frontend && npm run version:bump:patch
scripts.version:bump:minor: ./scripts/release.sh sync-versions && cd backend && npm run version:bump:minor && cd ../frontend && npm run version:bump:minor
scripts.version:bump:major: ./scripts/release.sh sync-versions && cd backend && npm run version:bump:major && cd ../frontend && npm run version:bump:major

author: GanttChart WebUI Team
